## Summary

When an Activity subtree is hidden, its passive effects are disconnected, which unsubscribes from the store. On reveal, the effects are reconnected by replaying the fiber's effect list without a render.

The fix unconditionally pushes the \updateStoreInstance\ effect so it is always in the effect list, tagged with \HookHasEffect\ only when a change was detected. This ensures reconnection always triggers the store check.

Fixes #27670.

## Test status

The original PR #36947 had a failing \eact-devtools-cdt-mcp e2e\ test which appears to be a flaky/infrastructure issue unrelated to the Fiber change.
